title.en: Google launches AI Mode in Search, the biggest change to how search works in 25 years
title.zhHans: Google 在搜索中推出 AI Mode，25 年来搜索方式的最大变革

searchSummary.en: Google launched AI Mode in Search in 2025 — the biggest change to how search works in 25 years. How AI-generated answers are transforming the web’s primary gateway.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 于 2025 年在搜索中推出 AI Mode——25 年来搜索方式的最大变革。AI 生成的答案如何改变了互联网的主要入口。

summary.en: On May 20, 2025, Google launched AI Mode in Search — a Gemini-powered feature that replaced the traditional list of blue links with AI-generated answers, comprehensive research reports, and multi-step reasoning. For the first time, the world's largest search engine could answer complex questions, compare options, and generate analysis directly, rather than linking to websites that might contain the answer. The change fundamentally altered the economics of the web: traffic to publisher sites dropped, and the definition of 'search' shifted from finding information to having information synthesized for you.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 5 月 20 日，Google 在搜索中推出了 AI Mode——一项由 Gemini 驱动的功能，用 AI 生成的答案、全面的研究报告和多步骤推理取代了传统的蓝色链接列表。全球最大的搜索引擎首次可以直接回答复杂问题、比较选项和生成分析，而不是链接到可能包含答案的网站。这一变化从根本上改变了网络的經濟模式：流向出版商网站的流量下降，"搜索"的定义从查找信息转变为为你整合信息。

narrative.en: For 25 years, Google Search had one dominant metaphor: ten blue links. You typed a query, Google found relevant web pages, and you clicked through. AI Mode changed that metaphor to: you ask a question, Google answers it. The feature, powered by a customized Gemini model, could: answer complex questions requiring multi-step reasoning; compare products, services, or options in table format; generate comprehensive research reports on any topic; and handle follow-up questions in a conversational context. AI Mode appeared as a tab alongside the traditional search results, allowing users to switch between 'classic' and 'AI' search. The launch was the culmination of Google's two-year journey with AI Overviews (2024) and represented the company's full embrace of generative AI in its core product. The impact on the web ecosystem was immediate and controversial. Publishers reported significant traffic drops as users got answers directly from Google without clicking through. SEO and content marketing industries faced an existential crisis. Google framed AI Mode as making search more useful, but critics argued it was a fundamental extraction of value from the web's content creators without compensation. AI Mode was initially US-only, rolling out globally through 2025-2026. By December 2025, Google upgraded it to Gemini 3 Flash. The launch was widely compared to Google's introduction of the PageRank algorithm in 1998 — a fundamental redefinition of what search means.
narrative.zhHans: 25 年来，Google 搜索有一个主导隐喻：十个蓝色链接。你输入查询，Google 找到相关网页，你点击进入。AI Mode 将这个隐喻改变了：你提问，Google 回答。该功能由定制的 Gemini 模型驱动，能够：回答需要多步骤推理的复杂问题；以表格格式比较产品、服务或选项；生成关于任何主题的全面研究报告；并在对话语境中处理后续问题。AI Mode 作为标签出现在传统搜索结果旁边，允许用户在"经典"和"AI"搜索之间切换。这次发布是 Google 与 AI Overviews（2024 年）两年旅程的最终成果，代表了公司对其核心产品中生成式 AI 的全面拥抱。对网络生态系统的影响是直接且有争议的。发布商报告了显著的流量下降，因为用户直接从 Google 获取答案而无需点击进入。SEO 和内容营销行业面临生存危机。Google 将 AI Mode 描述为使搜索更有用，但批评者认为这是从网络内容创作者处提取价值而不给予补偿的根本性行为。AI Mode 最初仅限美国，在 2025-2026 年全球推广。到 2025 年 12 月，Google 将其升级为 Gemini 3 Flash。这次发布被广泛比作 Google 在 1998 年引入 PageRank 算法——对搜索含义的根本性重新定义。

description.en: Fundamentally changed the metaphor of search from 'finding links' to 'getting answers.' Made AI-generated synthesis the default experience for the world's largest search engine. Comparable to PageRank's introduction in 1998.
description.zhHans: 从根本上改变了搜索的隐喻，从"找链接"变为"得答案"。使 AI 生成的综合回答成为全球最大搜索引擎的默认体验。可与 1998 年 PageRank 的引入相媲美。

description.en: Reduced traffic to publisher and content websites as users received answers directly. Threatened the economic model of web publishing, SEO, and content marketing. Raised fundamental questions about the sustainability of the open web.
description.zhHans: 减少了发布商和内容网站的流量，因为用户直接获取答案。威胁了网络出版、SEO 和内容营销的经济模式。对开放网络的可持续性提出了根本性质疑。

text.en: Google launched AI Mode in Search on May 20, 2025 — replacing traditional link-based search with Gemini-powered AI-generated answers.
text.zhHans: Google 于 2025 年 5 月 20 日在搜索中推出 AI Mode——用 Gemini 驱动的 AI 生成答案取代了传统的基于链接的搜索。

text.en: News publishers and content creators raised concerns that AI Mode's summarization would reduce traffic to original sources, undermining the economic model of web publishing.
text.zhHans: 新闻出版方和内容创作者担忧 AI Mode 的摘要功能会减少原始来源的流量，破坏网络出版的经济模式。

text.en: Fundamentally changed the metaphor of search from 'finding links' to 'getting answers.' Made AI-generated synthesis the default experience for the world's largest search engine. Comparable to PageRank's introduction in 1998.
